commentary_title: US tariffs continue to keep VLCC rates high
commentary_summary: The VLCC tonne-miles index fell slightly in week 6 ending the week at 99.7 points. Nevertheless, freight rates surged on most routes, especially on those headed towards China which increased by around 30% since the past week. Tonnage movement has been more active towards the West due to US' sanctions on Russian crude getting more stringent. | The MoM decline in vessels in port in the West declined by about 30%, as a lot of trade potential wore off during the week. Despite this, the weakness in tonnage supply continued to keep freight rates afloat.
